verdict.rationale: Docs and enthusiastic user testimonials show Tailscale enabling direct SSH/K8s/NAS access without a traditional VPN concentrator (tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-docs-8, tailscale-docs-18, tailscale-docs-19), and it markets itself as 'serverless' with peer-to-peer mesh connectivity. However, hands-on community reports contradict the 'no relay' claim in practice: one user notes 'sometimes I get connected to a DERP server, so that limits the network speeds across the internet' when NAT traversal fails (tailscale-comm-8), meaning direct connections aren't guaranteed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation acknowledging/quantifying DERP relay fallback rates, and independent benchmarks confirming direct-connection success rate.
